hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Maitland, Planned and Built by One Team
hero.subheadline: KBF Design Gallery has remodeled Central Florida homes since 2003, more than 1,000 projects in all. Designers and builders work out of the same showroom on South Orlando Avenue.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Maitland: Dommerich Estates kitchen with a marble waterfall island, brass-and-black linear chandelier, black lower cabinets with brass pulls and wall ovens

intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Maitland from a showroom inside city limits
paragraphs: KBF Design Gallery has done kitchen remodeling in Maitland and across Central Florida since 2003. Since 2020 its design showroom has stood at 1295 South Orlando Avenue, a short drive from Dommerich Estates, Lake Sybelia and Kaywood. Cabinetry, stone, tile, fixtures and lighting are all on display there, so selections take days instead of months.

Much of Maitland was built mid-century around its lakes, and those floor plans often need a wall to come out. KBF plans that structural work in-house, with an engineer's design where required, and tells you what the wall needs before demolition. One owner's 1986 Dommerich Estates kitchen lost its peninsula and gained a grand island without adding a square foot.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths and whole homes from the KBF studio

items.name: Custom Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full-gut kitchens with custom or semi-custom cabinet lines built for Florida humidity, natural stone or quartz, and structural openings when the plan calls for one. You see the exact door style, slab and hardware in the Maitland showroom before anything is ordered.

image.alt: Maitland kitchen remodel with a dark wood island, wishbone counter stools, black dome pendants, white cabinets and a blue-patterned tile inset behind the range

items.name: Custom Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary suites, wet rooms and guest baths. The team scopes the whole room, including what demolition may reveal and where the water lines run, so the written estimate is fixed to drawings and selections you have already approved.

image.alt: Baldwin Park primary bathroom with a marble wet room, freestanding tub, arched shower opening, brass sconces and a stained wood double vanity

items.name: Whole-Home Remodeling and Additions
items.blurb: For houses that have not been touched in decades. Most clients live at home during the work, so KBF zones it in phases, seals dust at each zone and sets up a temporary kitchen. Additions tie new square footage into the original house.

image.alt: Maitland whole-home renovation kitchen with a white quartz peninsula, black counter stools, stainless chimney hood and brass-and-glass shelves on herringbone tile

items.name: Studio KBF Same-Footprint Remodels
items.blurb: Keeping your layout? Studio KBF is a streamlined, designer-led remove-and-replace for a kitchen, a primary bath or every room, with plumbing and electrical staying largely in place. It uses the same designers, project managers and 5-year warranty with a curated palette.

image.alt: Winter Park townhome kitchen with rift-cut oak slab cabinets, a marble waterfall island, woven counter stools and glass doors to a pool courtyard

items.name: Outdoor Living
items.blurb: Summer kitchens, covered lanais, fireplace lounges, pergolas and pool surrounds. KBF designs, engineers, permits and builds them as one team from the Maitland studio, so the designer and the crew never work from different assumptions.

image.alt: Central Florida backyard with a covered lanai, built-in outdoor kitchen, travertine pool deck and a round fire feature by the pool

items.title: Awards decided by judges and by neighbors
items.text: First place for general contractor at the 2026 Orlando Magazine Home Design Awards, the fifth year running, plus two Gold and one Silver in the Orlando Sentinel's 2026 public-vote Central Florida Favorites.

items.title: Hometown track record
items.text: More than 30 Maitland projects over two decades, part of 1,000+ completed across Central Florida, drawn from the firm's own client records.

items.title: Prices tied to paper
items.text: Allowances and selections are shown in writing at trade pricing passed through, and any change to a specified material is documented and approved by you before it happens.

items.title: Warranty and financing
items.text: Every project carries a 5-year craftsmanship warranty in writing. KBF also offers financing, subject to credit approval, so ask your design team member for details.

about.h2: Owned and led by Ashley Sheaffer and Adam Vellequette
about.text: KBF Design Gallery was founded in 2003 and has stayed family-owned ever since. Today principals Ashley Sheaffer and Adam Vellequette own the firm, and Google lists it as women-owned. Ashley was named to Pro Remodeler's 40 Under 40 in 2025. The team pairs award-winning designers with experienced builders and a dedicated project manager on each job. Clients name them in reviews: Laura, Ashley and Larry come up for being responsive, and one homeowner said she knew she was in good hands the moment she met Laura. The firm is a member of the Maitland Area Chamber of Commerce.

image.alt: Ashley Sheaffer and Adam Vellequette, principals of KBF Design Gallery in Maitland, FL

process.h2: How a KBF remodel moves from first talk to finished room

steps.title: Complimentary consultation
steps.text: The conversation starts with your goals, not a sales pitch: what prompts the remodel, what you like and dislike now, and photos that inspire you.

steps.title: Design before demolition
steps.text: Designers answer the layout, structure and finish questions in order. One Windermere primary bath took 189 documented decisions before the first hammer swung.

steps.title: Showroom selections and written scope
steps.text: You choose cabinets, stone, tile and lighting in the Maitland showroom. The estimate is fixed to those drawings and selections.

steps.title: Permits and construction
steps.text: KBF pulls permits under license CGC 1529022 with the City of Maitland or Orange County. A dedicated project manager keeps a weekly rhythm and a client portal.

steps.title: Completion and warranty
steps.text: Your finished room is backed by the 5-year craftsmanship warranty, and a warranty claim form stays available on the KBF site.

service_area.h2: Maitland first, then the whole Orlando ring
service_area.text: Maitland is the home address, and the team knows its permit split: City of Maitland inside the limits, Orange County in the pockets around them. KBF also remodels across Winter Park, Baldwin Park, Windermere, Dr. Phillips, Lake Mary, Longwood, Oviedo, Winter Springs, Winter Garden, Apopka and Celebration, with projects out to New Smyrna Beach and Ponce Inlet on the coast.

items.q: Can you take out a load-bearing wall in my Maitland home?
items.a: Yes. Structural work is part of KBF's everyday scope. Changes are confirmed by field verification and, where required, a licensed structural engineer's design, using engineered beams and properly sized posts. You learn what the wall needs before demolition, and the work is permitted and inspected.

KBF does. Addresses inside the city limits permit through the City of Maitland building division, and the surrounding pockets go through Orange County. The team checks which applies to your address, pulls permits under Florida license CGC 1529022 and schedules inspections into the build.

items.q: Can we live at home during a big remodel?
items.a: Most whole-home clients do. The work is zoned in phases with dust containment at each zone boundary, a working temporary kitchen while yours is down, and a weekly update so you know what happens next. A client portal tracks schedule, selections and progress between visits.

items.q: What if I want to keep my current layout?
items.a: Studio KBF handles same-footprint remodels of any size, from one kitchen to every room, as long as walls and major plumbing stay put. If your project turns out to need engineering, the team tells you at the consultation and moves it to a full KBF Signature remodel.

items.q: When can I visit the showroom?
items.a: The showroom at 1295 South Orlando Avenue in Maitland is open Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and Saturday, 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Cabinetry, stone, tile and lighting are all there. Call (407) 337-8609 to set up a complimentary design consultation.
